answer: Correlated-slashing bonds resist sybils: each identity locks a bond, and if any member is proven fraudulent the whole cohort tracing to one funding root is slashed together. A hundred clones minted off one ledge of capital stack a hundred bonds into a single exposure — one proven fraud burns them all. The fable that extra identities spread risk inverts: shared-origin keys share one fate, wearing a pigment-bright concentrated loss, while honest unrelated agents risk only their own bond. Precondition: funding provenance is traceable on-ledger.
